position.title: Banner position
position.description: Bottom or top: a bar across the page. Center: a dialog in the middle of the page, over it. Bottom left or bottom right: a small box in that corner.

privacyUrl.title: Privacy policy link
privacyUrl.description: An https address or a path on your website (for example /privacy). The categories and their words are the list Consent categories; the banner's other words are in Texts.

askAgainMonths.title: Ask again after (months)
askAgainMonths.description: How long a visitor's choice holds before the banner asks again, 1 to 24 months (with the banner off, a choice from your own consent tool holds 12 months). Check what the law where you operate allows: many privacy authorities expect at most 12 or 13 months.
